standard: ITU Radio Regulations Appendix 3 (space services - space stations)
clause: Table I + note 10 + Sec.8 + Annex 1 Table 1 (boundary)
applies_to: all space stations (mandatory regulatory limit; SM.329 calls space limits design limits)
domain_at_victim_bands: SPURIOUS (all victim bands beyond AP3 Annex 1 boundary)
limit_form: 43 + 10 log P or 60 dBc whichever less stringent (mean power)
reference_plane: power supplied to the antenna transmission line
conservatism_for_RFI: highest permitted emission = most conservative compliant source

clause: Table 2 + notes (2)(3)(5)(6); Annex 4 Table 8; recommends 2.5 (waveguide); Annex 1 Sec.1.1.2
applies_to: same as RR AP3 (Category A = AP3)
limit_form: same as AP3; Table 8 absolute: -13 dBm if P<=50 W else 10 log P - 30 dBm
reference_plane: antenna transmission line; e.i.r.p. method (Annex 2 Sec.3.3) if port not accessible
decision: USED to confirm AP3 numbers and for the Ka waveguide argument (recommends 2.5)

decision: SENSITIVITY (procurement standard; applicability to this mission not confirmed)

standard: CCSDS 401.0-B-32 recommendation 2.4.16 Maximum permissible spurious emissions

limit_form: total power in any single spurious emission <= -60 dBc (dBc vs unmodulated carrier)
conservatism_for_RFI: more stringent than AP3 for S/ISL discrete lines; not a PSD
decision: ADOPTED for the discrete-spur check (secondary receiver channel); not used on the PSD mask

decision: NOT ADOPTED for victim bands (OOB-domain mask); noted for TM/DLS waveform design
evidence: CCSDS 413.0-G-3 Sec.2.2 and Annex B text extracted
